name: The Marotte of the Lord of Fools

source.note: Fool's Day prize or heirloom; the book's numbers, our words.

summary: A jester's rod from the dead marionette's hands, a focus that adds +1 to spell attacks and save DCs (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13). Coulrophobia: after you save against fear, your Reaction makes its source take the same save or be Frightened. Fortune's Fool: Hideous Laughter once a dusk, back on a natural 1. From level 7, Fool's Motley (False Life once a dusk).

powers.name: Fortune's Fool
powers.text: Hideous Laughter once a dusk; a natural 1 on any of your D20 Tests gives it back.

powers.name: Fool's Motley
powers.text: False Life, and your clothes turn to motley.
